edit.old:
Work on the supplied project artifacts. Inputs and framework code are fixed. Write only the requested output files in this directory; do not modify external source, provider configuration, quality thresholds or workload. The framework will execute and validate the output independently.
Choose useful diagnostic collectors for the frozen task objective from actual capability and trace evidence. Write collection.json following collection.schema.json and use names from available-collectors.json. The torch collector already ran. Nsys is optional and runs separately; select it when available and useful to resolve overlap, graph tracing or attribution questions. nccl_tuning captures actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions in a separate warmed worker; kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol. It does not join payload-size matches to operator groups or supply clean timing. device_telemetry samples available NVML PCIe rates, utilization and memory separately; these are device-wide readings with native windows, not per-collective bytes. collective_calibration runs a separate synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at actually observed sizes/dtypes, with correctness checks; it is a reference experiment, not a performance lower bound or model critical-path estimate. execution_timeline records a separate plain Torch trace, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization, per-device intervals, and optional passive CPU gradient post-accumulate callbacks. It reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown. It never replaces a communication hook or determines subsequent search actions. python_runtime runs a separate warmed cProfile call trace to investigate host dispatch and binding costs. It perturbs execution, and its inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations. binding_cost compares an additive candidate's parent and binding-only passthrough in clean AB/BA workers with full quality checks. It omits candidate build/computation and reports whole-invocation cost, not per-group effects. It is not applicable before any candidate exists or when bundles replace the parent; if selected, it also runs in subsequent candidate resource feedback. Never invent PCIe/NVLink traffic from logical payload or memcpy sizes. Nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer or prove bucket identity. Exact bucket links require native correlation and observed gradient-storage membership; otherwise retain ambiguous candidates. List unavailable dimensions with observed reasons. Do not request every counter indiscriminately, change the task, or run tools yourself. The framework verifies availability and retains missing fields as unknown. Read evaluation.json and revisions.json: these are the actual candidates' clean project measurements and binding summary; observations.json is its parent's earlier discovery. Choose diagnostics and one listed revision from the observed uncertainty; set the plan's revision field to its exact ID when requesting collection. Do not assume a performance regression is an algorithm cost or that calling a reference is necessarily fallback. The selected collectors run on this exact candidate in separate workers. An empty list is valid when further collection is not useful. No failure-category policy or prescribed optimization action is supplied. Read inputs/worker-environment.json before library/API inspection. The measured worker uses Python /root/autodl-tmp/dev-venv/bin/python; use that executable for CPU checks. Other system/Conda environments may have different library versions. GPU work remains in leased framework workers.

candidate_diagnostics records executed candidate Python calls, handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations, and limited scalar returns in a separate instrumented run. It does not compare intermediate tensors, measure per-site numerical errors, or locate the first numerical divergence. Those observations remain unavailable unless another actual collector supplies them.
For binding_cost, additive means the candidate retains all installed parent bundles and adds new bundles; it does not mean the replacement must add mathematical work. Direct module/project bindings are eligible under this condition, and no functional replacements does not imply zero binding overhead. Removing/replacing an installed parent bundle makes this passthrough comparison inapplicable.

usage.scope: Observed assistant message snapshots; provider estimates, not invoice
